patterns: APPSC asks single-fact place->mineral items (Kolar = gold, Bailadila haematite, Khetri/Malanjkhand copper, Kadapa asbestos, AP sole producer of apatite) and ore->metal items.
Recurring AP angle: mica (Nellore), asbestos/barytes (Kadapa), Vizag iron ore exports to Japan, rare earths in Anantapur (NGRI 2023), mineral-production shares 2021-22 (Odisha 44.11%).
APPSC also asks belt A/R (South-Western vs North-Eastern plateau), NW non-ferrous = copper, phlogopite/pegmatite = mica, placer = gold, first list of 30 critical minerals.
Many PYQs filed here are world-mineral items (Lake Superior, Karaganda, Nikopol, Weipa) - APPSC Group-1 does ask these, so the app lacks world-mineral coverage.
App MCQs over-weight chemistry ore formulas and 2025-26 policy minutiae (MMDR amendments, SC royalty case) in multi-statement form, deeper than APPSC's direct items.
